Totally get it—there’s a lot to pick from, kind of like standing in front of a huge BBQ buffet.

Here are your main options with us:

Subscription boxes: Choose your plan and customize size/frequency in your account under NEXT BOX → EDIT YOUR BOX → UPDATE CONTENTS, then SAVE.
One-time gift boxes: Great if you just want to try us out or send a present—you can browse available gift boxes and eGift Cards online.
What’s in the box: Members get access to 100+ products—from thick-cut steaks to gluten‑free chicken nuggets—always raised without added hormones or antibiotics, and free of 200+ banned ingredients.
Ingredient needs: Click on any product before adding it to your box to see ingredients, nutrition, allergen info (including gluten‑free notes), and sourcing details.
Promotions & deals:
Not a member yet? Check our homepage and the checkout “Choose Your Plan” flow for current sign‑up promos.
Already a member? Sign into your account and check the DEALS tab to see exclusive member deals for your next box.
Cooking inspiration: If you’re choosing based on what you like to cook, our online recipes and Just Cook blog can give you ideas for cuts and styles to try.
How to pay: We take all major credit/debit cards plus PayPal, ShopPay, and Google Pay. Some orders may be eligible for HSA/FSA reimbursement through our Truemed partnership, as noted on your email receipt.
In‑store option: If you’d rather just test a few things, some of our cuts are available fresh at Target nationwide and certain breakfast items frozen at Costco in the Pacific Northwest.

To help you choose, think about:

Whether you want a recurring subscription or a one‑time box/gift
Any dietary needs (gluten‑free, allergens)
How often you cook meat and how much freezer space you’ve got

Once you know those, you can customize your box contents and size in your account so it really fits your household and cooking style.
